name: How to audit an AI-generated UI
caption:
Auditing AI-generated UI isn't about redesigning from scratch. It's about spot-checking the details generation gets wrong quietly.

Three checks before it ships:

Hierarchy: can you tell what matters in three seconds?
States: check empty, error, loading and long-text cases.
System: compare spacing, typography and colour against your design tokens.

Trust the generation, but verify the details.

I turned this into the checklist I paste into every review. Comment AUDIT and I'll send it to you.

What's your go-to check when reviewing AI UI?

slides.body:
**Hierarchy:**
The banner and two filled buttons all shout. What matters in three seconds?

**States:**
A long name breaks the row. The activity panel is empty with no message.

**System:**
The second button has its own radius, size and colour. Check it against your tokens.
